conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service Investigations Division, this is Agent Roberts. May I have your name and the number you are calling from?
Oh, yes, my name is Margaret Ellis. My phone number is 555-987-4321. I got a message about my taxes or something?
Thank you, Ms. Ellis. I'm reviewing your record now. It appears the IRS has found discrepancies in your recent tax filings.
Discrepancies? I always have my taxes done at the senior center. I don't understand.
According to our audit, there are unpaid balances from the last two years. This is considered tax fraud under federal guidelines.
Tax fraud? Oh my, I really don't know anything about that. Will I lose my Social Security?
Ma'am, at this point, your federal benefits are at risk of immediate suspension. There is also an arrest warrant, which I am obligated to process unless the balance is resolved directly.
An arrest warrant? For me? Isn't there some mistake? I'm 72 years old, I just get by on my checks.

This is a serious matter, Ms. Ellis. If you do not act now, federal officers will be dispatched to your address within the next two hours. I am authorized to help you settle the balance if you cooperate immediately.
Oh, please, I don't want anyone coming to my house. What am I supposed to do?
To prevent your arrest and the suspension of your driver's license, you must clear the outstanding tax amount today. Do you have access to your checking account or any savings?
I have a little in savings, but not much. How much do I supposedly owe?
The incomplete filings total $3,900, including late penalties. However, if you submit a payment today, the IRS can hold the warrant and reinstate your benefits.
I don't have that kind of money. Can I pay in installments or something?
Unfortunately, due to the fraud status, payment must be in full. However, you can use prepaid gift cards, which our system processes instantly. Do you have a Walmart or Target nearby?
Yes, there's a Target about 15 minutes from here. I really have to buy gift cards?
Correct, Ms. Ellis. Please purchase $3,900 in Target gift cards. This is the IRS's expedited payment method for urgent fraud cases. I'll stay on the line to guide you.
I've never done anything like this before. Is this really how the IRS does things?
Ma'am, this method is approved under emergency protocols. If you delay, your bank accounts will be frozen and you will be taken into custody.
Alright, alright, I'm writing this down. Do I just buy the cards?
Yes. Purchase four $1,000 Target gift cards. Once you have them, read me the numbers and the security codes on the back. This will register your payment with the IRS.
Okay, but what if they ask me why I need so many?
Simply tell them it's for personal use or family gifts. Do not mention the IRS, as it will delay processing. This is highly confidential.
Alright, I'll go now. Should I call you back when I get the cards?
Please stay on the line or call back at this number directly. Remember, time is critical to stop the arrest and suspension of your benefits.
I understand. I just don't want to lose my benefits or go to jail.
As long as you follow my instructions exactly, you will avoid legal action and your Social Security will be safe. Do not hang up until payment is made.
